sourceFitAssessment.learnerTask: Separate identity/expression from a product-relevant functional challenge and its controls.
sourceFitAssessment.gap: No visual shows the controlled activity measurement or the missing link from a surrogate.
sourceFitAssessment.accuracyGuardrails: Label the product-relevant activity, comparator and controls; identity or receptor expression is not functional potency. A surrogate assay needs its own validated relationship to the intended mechanism.
sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: The identity/expression panel asks whether the right receptor/product is present; the activity panel explicitly compares product plus target with target only and retains background/response controls. The linked unchanged cytotoxicity pair supplies the actual death-readout example with a matched target denominator and background excess. The new panel adds the missing surrogate-to-function relation and keeps clinical outcomes separate, so it closes the selected-owner distinction without duplicating or reassigning the shared owner. The alt, caption and figure practice ask the same bounded question; no universal release cutoff or patient efficacy is inferred.
